about: Shadow sources for data/stories/S29 (who builds an AI agent's parts), read from the companies' own sites on 12 November 2026, not from websummit.com. STAGED here, not yet merged into data/stories/S29/, because the build treats S29 as entirely websummit-only (board/team/dev.data/findings/2026-11-11-websummit-only-in-story-folders.json) and keeps the whole folder out; adding these claims to the folder would change that classification before the build filters claims one by one. Merge them (sources into sources/, claims renumbered after c16) once dev@ confirms claim-level filtering. Not covered: Polygraf AI, whose site is behind a bot challenge (not read around), and the article's exact phrases (the own-site wording differs, noted in each claim).

claims.text: Mastra's own site says its core framework is open source under the Apache 2.0 licence (the Web Summit page calls it an open source TypeScript framework; the home page title is 'TypeScript AI Framework for Agents and Apps').
claims.quote: Mastra's core framework is open source under the Apache 2.0 license.

claims.text: Keewano's own site describes KeewanoDB as the database for machine reasoning over complete event sequences (it says 'machine reasoning'; the Web Summit page says 'for AI agents').
claims.quote: KeewanoDB The database for machine reasoning over complete event sequences.

claims.text: Acrab's own site gives its vision as defining the infrastructure for agentic AI compute.
claims.quote: Defining the Infrastructure for Agentic AI Compute

claims.text: Humanos's own site says every AI agent builds a continuously evolving risk profile from its identity, authority, controls and runtime activity (it speaks of a Risk Score; the term 'Risk Passport' is not on the home page).
claims.quote: Every AI agent builds a continuously evolving risk profile from its identity, authority, controls and runtime activity.

claims.text: GetVocal's own site describes its control layer as air-traffic control for an AI fleet: monitor live, enforce policies, override any agent and audit every decision.
claims.quote: Air-traffic control for your AI fleet: monitor live, enforce policies, override any agent and audit every decision.

claims.text: Beyond Presence's own site is titled 'Real-Time AI Avatars for Enterprise'; the home page does not describe agents in the sense of the article.
Cnext's own site says it helps businesses in regulated industries build and implement agentic AI in their processes.
claims.quote: Cnext helps businesses in regulated industries build and implement agentic AI in their processes.

claims.text: Cnext's own site says it all runs on Kairos, its own engine.
claims.quote: it all runs on Kairos, our own engine
